topic.title: Compatibility of grouped history evidence and target-conditioned readout
topic.question: Does combining the strongest history representation with target-conditioned readout outperform both frozen source bests, especially paired_match, under the same visible inputs and training protocol, with capacity and measured cost controlled?
topic.hypothesis: The separate source gains motivate testing whether target-conditioned readout can use information retained by grouped history representations. They do not establish complementary mechanisms and may reflect redundant target matching. Preserve both frozen source bests as utility controls and use matched-capacity, target-independent readout controls to distinguish conditioning from extra capacity. Failure to exceed paired_match would leave incremental utility unsupported; gains matched by the target-independent control would leave conditioning unsupported. Reserve budget for attribution and repetition, and report training and inference cost alongside AUC and logloss.
